entry.title: New: Bill 117 (2023) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, APPENDIX A, PART I, DEPARTMENT OF THE PROSECUTING ATTORNEY" The purpose of this bill is to increase the appropriation for the Career Criminal Program in the amount of $107,548 and the appropriation for the Victim/Witness Assistance Program in the amount of $288,094.
